prompt: The video begins with a first-person perspective walking along Castle Rock Beach in Meelup, Australia, under a cloudy and foggy night sky. The camera moves steadily forward, capturing the sandy terrain interspersed with scattered rocks and patches of vegetation. As the viewer progresses, the dim ambient light reveals the gentle waves lapping against the shore, their white foam contrasting subtly with the dark sand. The camera pans slightly to the right, showcasing a dense line of trees and shrubs bordering the beach, their silhouettes stark against the muted backdrop. The scene transitions smoothly as the camera continues its forward motion, revealing more of the rocky outcrops that define the landscape. The camera angle shifts subtly, offering a broader view of the beach's expanse, with the horizon barely visible through the fog. The lighting remains consistently low, casting long shadows and creating an atmosphere of quiet solitude. As the walk continues, the camera captures the intricate textures of the sand and rocks, emphasizing the natural beauty of this secluded coastal area. The overall ambiance is serene and untouched, with no signs of human presence, enhancing the sense of isolation and tranquility.
